integrity: Analytic polynomial identity and uniqueness proof; finite executable checks are supporting, not the proof; no independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp constant applies only to the two-window Gaussian-envelope-corrected ambiguity gain; unweighted gain decays at infinity, and full nonlinear phase retrieval stability is not established. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp Gaussian-envelope stability for the first two non-Gaussian Hermite windows
